positions.name: CalibrationGroundedInReferenceVerification
positions.frame: what grounds the claim that the Kestrelwood calibration is correct and holding?
positions.why: All three expressions read in the same direction: a specific instrument (src-2) is asserted calibrated to a specific frequency (src-3), and that state is claimed true because it was checked against a named external standard — the June reference plates — rather than asserted on authority alone. The labelled-field segments (src-2, src-3) are the compressed scaffolding of the same verification claim src-1 makes in full sentences; register and conviction reads agree these are flat, unhedged, claim-level assertions with no ratification move beyond the verification act itself.
